translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Nabir, emi anmar egi-sunmakdanikidi, anmar sogdanido, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad an nikmaladi, Bab-Dummad-olo-gana argan-nuedsik nibneggi sigdapye.
We-Jesúsde Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-islidikidgi arbaedid, Bab Dummad nibneggine na e-neg-sobsadgi. We-neg-islidikidde, dulemar sobsasulid.

Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-nugsalegedi, belagwapa we Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uked, degine, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-gummakar-ukega nugsaleged. Amba deyob Jesucristo ibmar Bab Dummadga ukmogar-gebed.
Degisoggu, we-napneggi Jesús gudiina, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golega guosulinad, ar ade amba we-napneggi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad gudidiid, amar Moisés-igar-maidba Bab Dummadga ibmar-ukmalad.

We-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-arbamalad-nega, Bab-Dummad-meged-neg-sunnadsulid, unnila e-wilubgan gued, ar Bab-Dummad-meged-neg-sunnaddi nibneggi siid. A-ular Moisés Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg sobe-sokargu, Bab Dummad Moisésga sogsa-gusad:

Ar emigindi Jesús, Bab-Dummadga-arbaedi baiganba bur-nuedid, ar ade Jesucristo, igar-bini-megisad-irwa gwisguega nug imaklesad, we-igar-binid igar-seredba bur-nuedid, degine, Bab-Dummad-yoedse-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad bur biriginedbalid.
Gebe-igar-megisad we-igar bela swilidikina, ar bar a-sorba we-igar-baid abelegosulinad.
Bab Dummad na e-igar-idu-megisadba e-dulemar geg nue-nana daksasoggu, a-ular we-gebe-igar-megisad-nik Bab Dummad soged:

content.text: Ani an Bab Dummad, ani an soged, ibagan danikoed,
Deginbali, e-iskumalad bela an ega elioed,

content: Bab Dummad sogedi: Igar-binidye, sognaido, igar-idualed seredgusye. Ar igar-seredye sogedi, we-igar sered-gusale, a-igar bato bergued warmakdanisundo.
